nickname.match: Match each athlete to their nickname.

rows.label: Cristiano Ronaldo
rows.hook: won five Ballon d'Ors and became men's international football's all-time top scorer

rows.label: Lionel Messi
rows.hook: won a World Cup in Qatar and holds a record haul of Ballon d'Or awards

rows.label: Erling Haaland
rows.hook: scored a record 36 goals in one Premier League season for Manchester City

rows.label: Harry Kane
rows.hook: became England's all-time leading men's goalscorer while starring for Tottenham

rows.label: Michael Jordan
rows.hook: led the Chicago Bulls to six NBA titles and teamed up with cartoon characters in a hit movie

rows.label: Novak Djokovic
rows.hook: has won more men's major singles titles than any other player

rows.label: Peyton Manning
rows.hook: quarterbacked the Colts and Broncos and won five NFL MVP awards

rows.label: Muhammad Ali
rows.hook: famously said he would float like a butterfly and sting like a bee

rows.label: Shaquille O'Neal
rows.hook: won four NBA titles as a giant center and later became a TV analyst

rows.label: Roger Federer
rows.hook: won eight Wimbledon men's singles titles with a famously graceful game

rows.label: Dennis Rodman
rows.hook: won five NBA rebounding titles and was famous for ever-changing hair colors

rows.label: Kawhi Leonard
rows.hook: won Finals MVP with both the Spurs and the Raptors

rows.label: Michael Schumacher
rows.hook: won seven Formula One world championships, five of them with Ferrari

rows.label: Mike Tyson
rows.hook: became the youngest heavyweight boxing champion ever and once bit an opponent's ear

rows.label: Deion Sanders
rows.description: American football and baseball player and football coach
rows.hook: was a flashy NFL cornerback who also played Major League Baseball

rows.label: Babe Ruth
rows.hook: hit 714 career home runs, most of them for the New York Yankees

rows.label: Kobe Bryant
rows.hook: spent his whole NBA career with the Lakers and once scored 81 points in a game

rows.label: Mohamed Salah
rows.hook: became a Liverpool star and won several Premier League Golden Boots

rows.label: Rafael Nadal
rows.hook: won a record 14 French Open titles on the red dirt of Paris

rows.label: Zinedine Zidane
rows.description: French association football player and coach
rows.hook: led France to a World Cup win by scoring two headers in the final

rows.label: Wayne Rooney
rows.hook: became Manchester United's all-time leading goalscorer

rows.label: John McEnroe
rows.hook: was a tennis champion as famous for angry outbursts at umpires as for his shots

rows.label: Ronaldo
rows.hook: won two World Cups and starred as a striker for Barcelona, Inter and Real Madrid

rows.label: David Beckham
rows.hook: was famed for bending free kicks and marrying a Spice Girl

rows.label: Sachin Tendulkar
rows.hook: scored 100 international centuries, more than any other batter

rows.label: Steffi Graf
rows.hook: won all four tennis majors plus Olympic gold in a single year

rows.label: Jon Jones
rows.hook: dominated the UFC light heavyweight division before moving up to heavyweight

rows.label: Conor McGregor
rows.description: Irish boxer and mixed martial arts fighter
rows.hook: became the first UFC fighter to hold titles in two weight classes at once

rows.label: Diego Maradona
rows.hook: scored a goal with his hand and a famous solo goal in the same World Cup match against England

rows.label: Khabib Nurmagomedov
rows.hook: retired undefeated as UFC lightweight champion

rows.label: Brett Favre
rows.hook: started a record streak of consecutive NFL games at quarterback

rows.label: Manny Pacquiao
rows.description: Filipino boxer, basketball player, singer, actor, politician and philanthropist
rows.hook: won world boxing titles in eight weight classes and later served in his country's senate

rows.label: Pelé
rows.hook: won three World Cups with Brazil and is widely called the greatest footballer ever

rows.label: Kevin Durant
rows.hook: won two NBA titles and Finals MVPs with Golden State after leaving Oklahoma City

rows.label: Floyd Mayweather
rows.hook: retired from boxing with an unbeaten record of 50 wins

rows.label: Derek Jeter
rows.description: American former professional baseball player, author, bussinessman and baseball broadcasters
rows.hook: spent his whole career as the New York Yankees' shortstop and won five World Series

rows.label: Giannis Antetokounmpo
rows.hook: led the Milwaukee Bucks to an NBA title and won two straight MVP awards

rows.label: Florence Griffith Joyner
rows.hook: set sprint world records that still stand and was known for flashy one-legged running suits

rows.label: Michael Phelps
rows.hook: won 23 Olympic gold medals, more than anyone in history

rows.label: Johan Cruyff
rows.hook: starred in the 'Total Football' style for Ajax and the Netherlands

rows.label: Wilt Chamberlain
rows.hook: scored 100 points in a single NBA game

rows.label: Allen Iverson
rows.hook: was a small, crossover-dribbling guard for the 76ers who famously ranted about practice

rows.label: Antoine Griezmann
rows.hook: won a World Cup with France and starred for Atletico Madrid

rows.label: Wayne Gretzky
rows.description: Canadian ice hockey player and coach (born 1961)
rows.hook: holds NHL records for goals, assists and points and wore number 99

rows.label: Lou Gehrig
rows.hook: set a long streak of consecutive games for the Yankees before a fatal illness ended his career

rows.label: MS Dhoni
rows.hook: captained India to a World Cup win and is famous for finishing games with a six

rows.label: Carlos Tevez
rows.hook: played for both Manchester United and Manchester City

rows.label: Tony Hawk
rows.hook: was the first skateboarder to land a 900 and fronts a hit video game series

rows.label: Joe DiMaggio
rows.hook: hit safely in 56 straight games and married Marilyn Monroe

rows.label: Karl Malone
rows.hook: spent most of his career with the Utah Jazz alongside John Stockton

rows.label: Walter Payton
rows.description: American football running back, Pro Football Hall of Famer (1954-1999)
rows.hook: was the NFL's career rushing leader when he retired as a Chicago Bears star

rows.label: Evander Holyfield
rows.hook: won heavyweight titles four times and lost a fight when an opponent bit his ear

rows.label: Oscar De La Hoya
rows.hook: won Olympic gold at Barcelona and later titles in six weight divisions

rows.label: Rocky Marciano
rows.hook: retired as heavyweight champion with an unbeaten record of 49 wins

rows.label: Sergio Agüero
rows.hook: scored a last-minute goal that won Manchester City the Premier League title

rows.label: Lawrence Taylor
rows.hook: revolutionized the linebacker position for the New York Giants

rows.label: Francesco Totti
rows.hook: spent his entire career with Roma and won the World Cup with Italy

rows.label: Russell Westbrook
rows.hook: averaged a triple-double for a season and won MVP with Oklahoma City

rows.label: Dwyane Wade
rows.hook: led the Miami Heat to a title and later teamed up with LeBron James

rows.label: Alexander Ovechkin
rows.hook: passed the record for most career goals in the NHL

rows.label: Mickey Mantle
rows.hook: was the switch-hitting slugger of the New York Yankees' dynasty, famed for monstrous home runs

rows.label: Dale Earnhardt
rows.hook: drove the black number 3 car and was a seven-time stock car champion who died in a last-lap crash at Daytona

rows.label: Pete Rose
rows.hook: collected more hits than anyone in baseball history, famed for sprinting to first base on a walk

rows.label: Ángel Di María
rows.hook: is a speedy winger who scored the winning goal in an Olympic final and a World Cup final

rows.label: Nikola Jokić
rows.hook: is a passing center who won multiple league MVP awards for the Denver franchise

rows.label: Boris Becker
rows.description: German tennis player, coach, and commentator (born 1967)
rows.hook: won Wimbledon at age 17, the youngest man ever to do so, with a thunderous serve

rows.label: Marco van Basten
rows.description: Dutch association football player and manager (born 1964)
rows.hook: scored an acrobatic volley in a European Championship final and won three Ballon d'Or awards

rows.label: Hakeem Olajuwon
rows.hook: was a center famed for his footwork who led the Houston Rockets to back-to-back titles

rows.label: Randy Johnson
rows.description: American Hall of Fame baseball pitcher (born 1963)
rows.hook: was a towering left-handed pitcher with a fearsome fastball and a famous mullet

rows.label: Paul Gascoigne
rows.description: English association football player and manager (born 1967)
rows.hook: was a tearful, mischievous midfielder who starred at Italia 90 and was known for his off-field antics

rows.label: Reggie Jackson
rows.hook: earned his reputation hitting three home runs in a single World Series game

rows.label: Tim Duncan
rows.hook: won five titles with the San Antonio Spurs by mastering the basics rather than flash

rows.label: Ted Williams
rows.description: American baseball player and fighter pilot
rows.hook: was the last hitter to bat over .400 in a season, and lost years to military service as a pilot

rows.label: Franz Beckenbauer
rows.description: German sports official and association football player (1945–2024)
rows.hook: was an elegant defender who captained and later coached his country to World Cup glory

rows.label: Kevin Garnett
rows.hook: was a fiery power forward who won a title with the Boston Celtics after years in Minnesota

rows.label: Jesse Owens
rows.hook: won four gold medals at the Berlin Olympics held under the Nazi regime

rows.label: Alessandro Del Piero
rows.hook: is a longtime Juventus captain and the club's record scorer, famed for a free kick curling into the top corner

rows.label: Cal Ripken Jr.
rows.hook: broke Lou Gehrig's record by playing in 2,632 consecutive games for the Baltimore Orioles

rows.label: Joe Louis
rows.hook: was a heavyweight champion who held the title for twelve years and beat a German rival in a famous rematch

rows.label: Roberto Baggio
rows.hook: was a gifted playmaker with a tied-back hairstyle who missed the decisive penalty in a World Cup final

rows.label: Roberto Durán
rows.hook: was a ferocious lightweight champion who famously quit in a rematch saying he would fight no more

rows.label: Andrea Pirlo
rows.description: Italian association football player and manager
rows.hook: was a bearded midfielder known for deep-lying passing and a cheeky chipped penalty

rows.label: Ty Cobb
rows.hook: was a fiercely competitive outfielder who retired with a record batting average that stood for decades

rows.label: Vince Carter
rows.hook: is a high-flying guard who won the slam dunk contest and played a record number of NBA seasons

rows.label: Edinson Cavani
rows.hook: is a striker who scored heavily for Paris Saint-Germain and played for Manchester United

rows.label: Anderson Silva
rows.hook: was a long-reigning middleweight champion in the UFC with stunning striking finishes

rows.label: Lev Yashin
rows.hook: was a goalkeeper who always wore dark kit and is the only keeper to win the Ballon d'Or

rows.label: Anthony Davis
rows.hook: is a shot-blocking big man famed for his unibrow and for winning a title with the Lakers

rows.label: Shoaib Akhtar
rows.hook: was a fast bowler who delivered the ball at over 160 km/h, among the quickest ever measured

rows.label: Ferenc Puskás
rows.hook: was a left-footed Hungarian star of Real Madrid whose goal tallies rival the all-time greats

rows.label: Joel Embiid
rows.hook: is a center who has won a scoring title and MVP for the Philadelphia 76ers

rows.label: Julius Erving
rows.hook: was a high-flying forward whose acrobatic dunks from the free-throw line thrilled ABA and NBA fans

rows.label: Willie Mays
rows.hook: made a famous over-the-shoulder catch in the World Series and hit over 600 home runs

rows.label: Arnold Palmer
rows.hook: won seven major golf titles and built a legion of fans, with a fruity drink named after him

rows.label: Jack Dempsey
rows.hook: was a heavyweight champion of the 1920s whose bouts drew the first million-dollar gates

rows.label: Phil Mickelson
rows.hook: is a left-handed golfer who has won multiple majors, including the PGA Championship at age 50

rows.label: Jack Nicklaus
rows.hook: won a record 18 major golf championships and six Masters green jackets

rows.label: Jerry West
rows.hook: is said to be the player whose silhouette appears on the emblem of the National Basketball Association

rows.label: Luis Suárez
rows.hook: is a prolific striker who famously bit an opponent at a World Cup and starred for Barcelona and Liverpool

rows.label: Thomas Hearns
rows.hook: was a lanky, hard-punching boxer who won titles in five weight classes and fought Sugar Ray Leonard

rows.label: Brian Lara
rows.hook: holds the record for the highest individual Test cricket score, a mighty 400 not out

rows.label: Gerd Müller
rows.hook: was a prolific German striker who scored the winning goal in a World Cup final

rows.label: Kapil Dev
rows.hook: captained his country to a stunning upset victory in a Cricket World Cup final at Lord's

rows.label: Rahul Dravid
rows.hook: was an unflappable India batsman who defended stubbornly and scored many hundreds abroad

rows.label: Eusébio
rows.hook: was a Mozambique-born star who led Portugal to third place at a World Cup and won the Golden Boot

rows.label: Gordie Howe
rows.hook: played pro ice sports across five decades and is famed for scoring, assisting and fighting in one game

rows.label: Greg Norman
rows.hook: was a blond Australian golfer who held the top world ranking for many weeks and blew a big lead at Augusta

rows.label: Gary Player
rows.hook: always dressed in dark clothing and won nine major titles, becoming one of golf's Grand Slam winners

rows.label: Oliver Kahn
rows.hook: was a ferocious goalkeeper who won the Golden Ball at a World Cup despite losing the final

rows.label: Ian Botham
rows.description: former England Test cricketer and Test team captain, and current cricket commentator (born 1955)
rows.hook: was an all-rounder whose heroics in an Ashes Test at Headingley are legendary

rows.label: Ricky Ponting
rows.hook: was a pugnacious Australian captain who won two World Cups and was a prolific run scorer

rows.label: Oscar Robertson
rows.hook: was the first player to average a triple-double over a full NBA season

rows.label: Eddy Merckx
rows.hook: won the Tour de France five times and is often called the greatest road cyclist ever
